mechanism_of_action: Sulforaphane increased Bacteroides and Lactobacillus, promoting SCFA production and GPR41/43 activation, which increased GLP-1; it also protected the intestinal mucosal barrier and reduced inflammation.
efficacy_outcome: In the human NAFLD intervention, GLP-1 increased and was positively correlated with reductions in blood glucose and HOMA-IR; no numerical results were reported. In HFD-fed rats, SFN reduced blood glucose and HOMA-IRI and increased insulin sensitivity.
